neighbours.label: possessive pronoun (his/her/your) where a relative or family member is expected next (his family, her husband, his cousin)
fire: The young widow refused to speak ill of her late husband.
Every summer the boy was sent to stay with his uncle on the farm.
The duke quarreled bitterly over the inheritance with his cousin.
Tomorrow the queen will receive a letter from her sister.
Ashamed of his debts, he could not face his family.
The servant hurried to report the news to his master.
When she married, she took the name of her husband.
The orphan was raised by her grandmother in a small village.
quiet: The young widow refused to sell the old farmhouse.
Every summer the boy painted his bicycle on the farm.
The duke quarreled bitterly over the inheritance with the lawyers.
Tomorrow the queen will open a letter on her desk.
Ashamed of his debts, he sold his horse.
The servant hurried to polish his boots.
When she married, she kept her own name.
The orphan was raised in a small village by the sea.
